entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh! It does seem like there'd be lots of[n]students in Shibuya. Maybe we'll get[n]some new information!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Where could Ryuji be?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, you're early.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, let's get goin'!
Let's do this.
Is everyone ready?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The calling card's been posted all over[n]Shibuya...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A good idea, no?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Given the theatrical nature of this one,[n]Kaneshiro must surely have been[n]contacted about it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You truly are the brains of this Phantom[n]Thieves operation! Ryuji, you should[n]follow her example!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know I'm the one who went postin' it[n]everywhere, right!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I even had to get all dressed up so they[n]wouldn't notice me!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come now, we don't have the time for[n]idle chitchat. Let us get moving.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're going up against a truly horrible[n]criminal this time...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That dick ain't gonna stop us now that[n]we got our awesome new member!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Makoto! You remember how all this[n]works?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Once we steal the Treasure, the Palace[n]will crumble and the Palace ruler's heart[n]will change.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow, you got that quick! I think Ryuji's[n]still struggling to comprehend it all...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The old me is dead. Makoto the[n]sycophant is gone... and the corrupt[n]adults who controlled her are next!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sounds like you're fired up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, Joker! Give us the signal!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The day has come. Are you all prepared?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What of the calling card, Makoto?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I showed it to Sis... She took it from my[n]very own hands...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Makoto...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I understand how you feel, but you mustn't[n]be so downtrodden.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah... If we screw this up, we're done for.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's way more than losin' the place[n]we belong... We could even lose[n]our lives here, y'know.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It will be all right. I want to save my sister,[n]no matter what.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is everyone decided?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mm-hm! All's well that ends well!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So much has happened since we first[n]started... You guys have become quite[n]the reliable team.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, Joker! This is the Phantom[n]Thieves' final heist! Give us the signal!
